name: url-shortener
description: URL shortener with real-time analytics — a phase-by-phase learning project

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --import tsx --test test/base62.test.ts test/codes.test.ts test/links.test.ts test/batch.test.ts test/events.test.ts test/vercelPath.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: node --import tsx --test test/cache.test.ts test/rateLimit.test.ts test/trending.test.ts test/liveFeed.test.ts test/partitions.test.ts test/kafka.test.ts test/minimal.test.ts test/api.test.ts
scripts.k8s:validate: kubectl kustomize k8s/ | docker run --rm -i ghcr.io/yannh/kubeconform:latest -strict -summary -kubernetes-version 1.30.0 -
